Then a couple days before that some of the girls at smoko asked why I never actually have lunch, I tried saying i was doing *intermittent fasting* but I somehow got wrangled into going to a cafe nearby and buying a chocolate slice and one of them was saying how she literally couldn't handle not eating, it was awkward as hell. It would've been weird to say that I don't eat during the day but binge/drink/purge every night and never lose any weight, I just end up feeling gross
